properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated January 19, [1936]; includes description of financial crisis in Shanghai; family matters; mentions [William L. and Kitsi] Bond, M.Y. Tang, Mr. Twogood, Mr. and Mrs. Sprague, Miss Lockhart, [C.S] Russell, Dick Vandenberg, “Raven and Brown,” Lane Crawford, Charley Nash, [Dr.] Frances Nance.
